codex-app-server-setup.title: Prepare Codex App Server
codex-app-server-setup.intro: Create an explicit provider configuration for the target machine. This protocol is separate from Codex JSONL.
codex-app-server-setup.help.executable: Absolute path on the target machine; shell launchers and JavaScript entries are not accepted.
codex-app-server-setup.help.providerID: Use the exact provider identifier configured for this connection.
codex-app-server-setup.help.baseURL: HTTPS, or loopback HTTP. Do not include credentials, query parameters or fragments.
codex-app-server-setup.help.credentialEn: Enter a variable name available to the target Runner. Keep the credential value outside this form.
codex-app-server-setup.sandbox_help: Windows targets require an explicit sandbox choice. The browser does not infer the target operating system.
codex-app-server-setup.help.commands: Absolute path to a new file on the target machine. Existing files are not overwritten.
codex-app-server-setup.user_input: Allow explicit user-input requests during task execution
codex-app-server-setup.boundary: This command only prepares a local file. It does not install or run Codex, read a credential, query a model, register a tool or enable dispatch.
codex-app-server-setup.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed command.
codex-app-server-setup.incomplete: Choose the target shell and complete the public configuration to generate a command.
